label: sairaly
desc: Upright plant with several rounded, deeply lobed green leaf clusters on a pale stem; horizontal brown segmented root at base.

label: otaldy
desc: Plant with a small round flower-like head on top, symmetric fringed/fern-like green leaves, and a single orange carrot-like taproot.

label: otol
desc: Radial plant: pointed dark-green leaves with looped bases arranged like a star around a thin branched stem; two small orange tuber roots below. Label lies between this and the tall vine to its right.

label: ytal
desc: Tall thin stem with alternate lobed, ivy-like green leaves; stem continues down toward a star-flowered outline plant.

label: dokor
desc: Thin upright plant with a single narrow pale-green leaf on a straight stem. Label ink reads d-o-tall-o-r; it is squeezed between this plant and the red-leaved plant on its right.

label: orar
desc: Plant with rounded scalloped green leaves on a short stem and a spreading branched brown root resembling legs. Label text read here as a-r-o-d, match to orar uncertain.

label: otarar
desc: Single large round green leaf with toothed edge and a notch, on a short stalk; long horizontal comb-like brown root.

label: otoly
desc: Coiled spiral-shaped round green leaf with an inner curl, thin stalk below. Label also close to the leafy plant to its right.

label: soraly
desc: Upright plant with whorls of pointed lance-shaped green leaves; flat tan root mass at the base. Label faint; leading glyph unclear.

label: okol
desc: Plant with a pale stem carrying paired red-orange hooked leaves; small forked orange-tan root. Label faint (o + minims + tall glyph), match to okol uncertain; also near the tall white-stemmed plant on the right.

label: arom
desc: Label not identified on 101v_part.jpg or 101v_panel2.jpg; panel2 has two labels cut off at the right edge (about [1360,190] and [1395,545]) that may be one of these.

label: oraram
desc: Plant with a dark brown-green tuft on top, two long green leaves arching down like arms, and a long horizontal tan root. Ink reads roughly o-tall-a-r-a-r/m, so the match to oraram is uncertain; it looks a lot like otarar.

label: oraeep
desc: Label not identified on 101v_part.jpg or 101v_panel2.jpg; panel2 has two labels cut off at the right edge (about [1360,190] and [1395,545]) that may be one of these.

label: dytolg
desc: Plant with two large round green leaf masses with scalloped edges on a short stem, small tan root.

label: olkor
desc: Plant with a branched pale stem carrying five rounded scalloped dark-green leaf clusters; short tan root.

label: dolary
desc: Two large dark-green heart/teardrop-shaped leaves joined at a single short stem; tiny dark root.

label: odor
desc: Plant with several long curving green leaves from a thick orange-tan root running diagonally. Label also lies right next to the oval leaf with a scalloped border on its left (about [985,520,1095,790]).

label: olaran
desc: Label not identified on 101v_part.jpg or 101v_panel2.jpg; panel2 has two labels cut off at the right edge (about [1360,190] and [1395,545]) that may be one of these.
